release: TASK-015 Slice 4a — message reports, moderator evidence and message redaction
rollback_note: SECURITY/PRIVACY BARRIER. No schema change (messages.redacted_at, reports.conversation_id and MESSAGE decisions exist since Slice 1), but rollback to Slice 5 is BLOCKED: the previous build serialises messages.body without looking at redacted_at, so every message a moderator removed (CONTENT_REMOVED) would be shown again to the conversation's participants. Never restart an image older than this release once a redaction exists. Recovery is forward repair only.
